title: I confirmed my erasure request, it was marked done, but my name, phone, note and public review are all still there
steps: Register a storefront customer and place a cash order at Mama Ade's Kitchen (tenant A)
Optionally leave a review for the completed order
POST /api/v1/public/gdpr/dsar {email, requestType:ERASURE}
Open the verification link from Mailhog (host rewritten 8080->9090)
Wait for the next fan-out sweep (5 min) and read core-java logs
Read the order via the vendor API and GET /api/v1/public/shops/mama-ades-kitchen/reviews
expected: Customer PII on orders anonymised, review anonymised, completion confirmed to the subject
actual: Log: event=dsar_fanout_completed tenantsErased=0 tenantsScanned=2. Order still holds customerName, customerEmail, customerPhone and notes ('I am slow to the door'); public review still shows 'Grace Persona14'; customer can still sign in and see both orders; no completion email. Cause (from code): GdprService.eraseSubjectByDigest iterates only `customers` rows, and storefront orders create none (tenant A: 7 customers, none for grace/jordan/sam/priya)
realWorldImpact: Every storefront customer's Article 17 request is reported satisfied while nothing is erased: an ICO-reportable compliance failure, and the request queue shows 'completed', so nobody notices

title: I asked for a copy of my data, confirmed it, and it will never be sent
steps: Lodge an ACCESS request for the customer email
Open the verification link (status verified)
Watch core-java logs over several 5-minute sweeps
expected: A copy of the data is delivered within one month
actual: Every sweep logs 'event=dsar_access_requests_outstanding count=1 — ACCESS delivery is not implemented in plan 31-09'. No email or download is ever produced
realWorldImpact: Statutory one-month Article 15 deadline missed for every requester; the subject was told 'your request is confirmed and will be actioned'

title: There is no account page: I can't close my account or ask for my data from the site
steps: Sign in as a customer at 360px
Open the menu: only 'Shops' and 'My Orders'
Try /account (404) and /shop/account (soft 'Shop not found')
Read the privacy notice: write to privacy@olajay.co.uk
Keycloak realm jtoye-customers: delete_account required action is disabled
expected: Account settings with 'Delete my account' and 'Download my data'
actual: mailto to a non-brand domain is the only route
realWorldImpact: Older customers without a configured mail app cannot exercise their rights; the backend intake exists but has no front door

title: After I pressed Place order the screen went dark: the confirmation was off-screen above
steps: 360px viewport, html font-size 130%
Fill the checkout, scroll down to Place order and tap it
expected: 'Order confirmed!' shown in view, with focus moved to it
actual: The viewport shows the footer. Measured scrollY 1104 of 1844, confirmation heading at -895px, document.activeElement = BODY. Reproduced on both orders
realWorldImpact: Customer believes the order failed, phones the shop or re-orders (double food, double cash)

title: No 'order again' button and my address isn't remembered, so my usual takes 10 taps and 85 keystrokes every week
steps: Week 2, fresh browser, open the shop link on Slow 3G
Sign in, add the same two items, check out
expected: Reorder from My Orders, with saved address and phone
actual: No reorder or favourites on My Orders or tracking; checkout pre-fills only name and email; address, postcode and phone blank. Total 10 taps, 85 chars, 83s
realWorldImpact: Regulars, the most valuable customers, get no repeat-order advantage over aggregators with one-tap reorder

title: I can't find anywhere to leave a review for my finished order
steps: Have the vendor complete the order
Check My Orders, the tracking page and the 'Completed' email for a review entry point
expected: A 'Rate your order' entry point
actual: None. The only path is POST /api/v1/public/shops/{slug}/reviews?email= with the order UUID, which no customer surface exposes (the tracking payload has no id)
realWorldImpact: The shop's reviews section (which exists) stays empty; vendors lose social proof

title: My full name is printed on the public shop page next to my review
steps: Create a review for a completed order
Open the shop page signed out
expected: First name or initial, or a stated choice
actual: 'Grace Persona14' (first + last name from the order) shown publicly and in the public API, with no notice
realWorldImpact: Exposes customers' full names to the internet; vulnerable or older customers may be identifiable alongside their locality

title: The password-reset link expired before my granddaughter could read me the email
steps: Forgot Password? and submit the email
Open the Mailhog link after 6 minutes
expected: A link valid for 30-60 minutes
actual: 'Action expired. Please start again.' (realm actionTokenGeneratedByUserLifespan = 300s; the email says 5 minutes)
realWorldImpact: Customers who read email late, or through someone else, are locked out and abandon

title: At large text the basket shows 'Jol…' and 'Fri…' instead of the dish names
steps: 360px, root font 130%
Add Jollof Rice and Fried Plantain and open the basket
expected: Names wrap
actual: h3 truncated to 3 letters with an ellipsis
realWorldImpact: Low-vision users cannot check their order before paying; wrong orders and complaints

title: The order tracker runs off the side of the screen at large text
steps: 360px, 130% text, signed in, open tracking
expected: All 5 steps visible
actual: 'Completed' step clipped; document scrollWidth 423 vs 360 (horizontal scroll) on both orders
realWorldImpact: The final state ('Completed') is the one the customer cannot see

title: The shop's own name is cut to 'Mama Ade's Ki…' and the header spills off-screen at large text
steps: 360px, 130% text, signed out, open the shop
expected: Name wraps; header fits
actual: h1 truncated; header nav right edge 364px (scrollWidth 364), menu icon clipped; 'Sign in' wraps over 2 lines
realWorldImpact: The shared WhatsApp link doesn't clearly show the trusted shop name

title: The green person icon does nothing, and the tiny unlabelled icon next to it signs me out
steps: Sign in at 360px
Tap the green circle: elementFromPoint is an svg labelled 'Storefront' with no link or button
Inspect the next icon: button title='Sign out', 18x18, no aria-label
expected: An account button opening account/settings; a labelled, confirmable sign-out
actual: Decorative icon that looks like an account button; 18px unlabelled one-tap sign-out
realWorldImpact: Mis-taps sign older users out; screen readers announce an unnamed button

title: The 'confirm your data request' link doesn't open, and when it does it shows code
steps: Lodge a DSAR on the compose stack
Open the emailed link
expected: A friendly confirmation page on the web app
actual: Link host localhost:8080: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (DSAR_VERIFY_BASE_URL unset in compose; set in k8s, so prod is SUSPECTED fine). With the host corrected, the response is raw application/json {"status":"verified",…}
realWorldImpact: On the canonical dev/E2E runtime no erasure can ever be confirmed; in prod a non-technical user sees JSON

title: The privacy notice says the shop is named on my confirmation, but neither the confirmation page nor the email names it
steps: Place an order
Read the confirmation page and the 'Received' email
Read /legal/privacy
expected: Shop named on the confirmation, as the notice promises
actual: Confirmation: 'Order confirmed! Order ORD-… · Pay on delivery' plus totals. Email: 4 lines with no shop name. Privacy notice: 'named … again on your order confirmation'
realWorldImpact: The customer cannot identify the other contracting party or data controller from their records

title: I can't tell what I agreed to about emails, and there is nowhere to change it
steps: Register and order
Look for email preferences
Read the privacy notice
Open /unsubscribe
expected: A clear statement (e.g. 'we only email about your orders') plus a preferences link
actual: No consent question anywhere; no preferences page; the privacy notice has no marketing section; /unsubscribe says 'Contact the vendor', and shops publish no contact. No marketing was received (good)
realWorldImpact: When marketing goes live, there is no customer-facing opt-in or opt-out surface

title: Password rules are hidden until I fail, one at a time, and my typing is wiped
steps: Register with 'Lewisham1956'
expected: Rules shown up front
actual: 'Invalid password: must contain at least 1 special characters.' Both password fields cleared. Policy is length 12 + upper + lower + digit + special. No privacy or terms link on the form
realWorldImpact: Repeated failures at sign-up; forgotten complex passwords drive the 5-minute reset problem

title: On my granddaughter's phone, with no order number, there is no way to find my food, and nothing says when it will come
steps: Fresh browser, open /track
Open the email tracking link signed out
expected: A 'Sign in to see your orders' route; an ETA
actual: Number + email form only; the email link pre-fills the number but needs the email typed; no ETA on any state
realWorldImpact: 'Where's my food' becomes a phone call to the shop

title: Reviews can be posted with no sign-in, just an email address in the URL
steps: POST with no Authorization header, ?email=<customer email>, body {orderId, ratings, comment}
expected: Customer JWT required (as /public/orders/mine already does)
actual: 201 Created, published under the customer's name
realWorldImpact: Anyone holding an order UUID and the customer's email (staff, logs) can publish a review in that customer's name

title: Emails come from two different addresses, say 'credentials', and never name the shop or what I ordered
steps: Place an order and reset the password; compare senders and bodies
expected: One sender; plain words; shop and items listed
actual: noreply@jtoye.uk vs no-reply@jtoye.local; 'change your account's credentials'
realWorldImpact: A granddaughter screening email may treat the reset as phishing

title: Tracking page logs a React hydration error and says 'Auto-refreshing' on a finished order
steps: Open /track?order=<completed order> signed in; watch the console
expected: No errors; no refresh label on terminal states
actual: Minified React error #418; 'Auto-refreshing' shown for COMPLETED
realWorldImpact: Minor; hydration errors can cause text mismatches

title: Cash on delivery is stated plainly: no card details needed
steps: Open checkout
actual: 'Pay on delivery — cash to the driver. No payment is taken online.'
realWorldImpact: Card-wary customers complete the order

title: Signed in, tracking finds my order without the order number
steps: Sign in and open /track
actual: 'Signed in — we found this one for you. No order number needed.'
realWorldImpact: Removes the biggest tracking barrier for regulars

title: An email at every step, and the Ready email knows it's a delivery
steps: Vendor advances a delivery order
actual: Confirmed / Being Prepared / Ready ('no need to come to the shop — we'll deliver it') / Completed
realWorldImpact: Fewer 'where is it' calls

title: At large text the product sheet, checkout and menu fit, and forgot-password returns me signed in to the shop
steps: Open View details at 130%
Complete a reset
actual: Dialog 666px within a 740 viewport, Close 42x42 visible, Escape closes; no horizontal scroll on checkout/basket; reset pre-fills email and lands back on the shop signed in
realWorldImpact: Preserve these when fixing the overflow defects
